themes.title: Transnational Recalibration Following MAGA Midterm Defeats
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and South America are re-evaluating their strategic alignments and messaging in the wake of the US midterm election results. European far-right leaders are actively distancing themselves from Trump's brand, while right-wing factions in the UK and Brazil face domestic political fallout linked to the MAGA setback.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Reeling from midterm losses, with internal party rebukes, personnel reshuffles, and Trump softening deportation rhetoric in national interviews.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Facing poll slumps as commentators frame Trump's midterm defeat as a major blow to Nigel Farage's populist momentum.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Allied governors abandon hardline Bolsonarismo rhetoric to seek pragmatic relations with Lula following Flávio Bolsonaro's post-election exit to the US.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: European right-wing factions evaluate post-midterm US strategy while broader European far-right networks distance themselves from Trump.

themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist parties across Europe are escalating campaign machinery and negotiating potential governing coalitions ahead of major regional and national votes. Parties in Spain, Sweden, France, Germany, and Italy are using policy debates and poll gains to pressure center-right rivals and reset coalition terms.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Ramping up campaign rallies and TV appearances ahead of the 29N regional vote, sparring with the PP over coalition conditions.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Åkesson executes strategic maneuvers, dropping explicit cabinet seat demands to pressure the Centre Party and pave the way for a Tidö 2 coalition.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella build early momentum for the 2027 presidential election through book signings, economic messaging, and opposition to wage hikes.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Polling strength in Thuringia and Saxony-Anhalt fuels debates over breaking the cordon sanitaire and forcing mainstream parties to engage.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Internal party tension peaks as Salvini's faction suffers a congress defeat in Varese amid coalition maneuvering with FdI.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Prominent right-wing figures and movements face escalating legal scrutiny, parliamentary investigations, and judicial oversight across multiple democracies. Right-wing leaders routinely frame these proceedings as politically motivated establishment overreach intended to neutralize opposition.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Supreme Court oversight intensifies around Flávio and Jair Bolsonaro regarding January 8 events and post-election flight to the US.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage comes under investigation by parliamentary watchdogs over an undeclared £5m donation from a crypto billionaire.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Congressional Democrats launch an impeachment push against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth alongside broader oversight of Trump appointees.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: State justice officials and church bodies evaluate party ban proceedings and surveillance leveraging leaked internal AfD materials.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Ongoing standoff between President Nawrocki and the Tusk government over control and legitimacy of the Constitutional Tribunal.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing nationalist parties in Western Europe and North America are sharpening demands for strict immigration enforcement, mandatory cultural integration, and anti-Islam measures. Policy proposals across borders focus on expelling non-assimilated migrants, restricting public religious symbols, and cutting municipal aid.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Jimmie Åkesson calls for demolishing mosques in Sweden to protect national culture and identity.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Pushes anti-burqa legislation in the Balearics and demands an immediate end to migrant distribution in El Hierro to eliminate pull factors.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen advocates expelling non-assimilated immigrants while denying systemic discrimination in France.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Demands mandatory labor requirements for asylum seekers in Schwerin and stricter municipal public order enforcement.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Debate over hardline deportation policies and strict border control remains central post-midterms.

themes.title: Transnational Right-Wing Networking and Parallel Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders and foreign policy figures are engaging in parallel diplomatic efforts and high-profile international engagements to assert national sovereignty and challenge international institutions. These efforts highlight dueling visions between nationalist executive power and global bodies.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
